### Repligen Announces $1 Billion Private Convertible Senior Notes Transaction


Oct 30, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/906585988/files/doc_news/Repligen-Announces-1-Billion-Private-Convertible-Senior-Notes-Transaction-2026.pdf)


WALTHAM, Mass., Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Repligen Corporation (NASDAQ:RGEN) (“Repligen”), today announced that it entered into privately negotiated exchange and/or subscription agreements with certain holders of its outstanding 1.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2028 (the “2028 Notes”) and certain new investors, pursuant to which Repligen will issue $1.0 billion aggregate principal amount of 0.25% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031 (the “New Notes”). Approximately $541.4 million principal amount of the New Notes will be issued in exchange for approximately $456.8 million principal amount of 2028 Notes (the “Exchange Transactions”) and approximately $458.6 million principal amount of the New Notes will be issued for cash (the “Subscription Transactions”, and together with the Exchange Transactions, the “Transactions”). The conversion price for the New Notes will initially be approximately $226.37 per share of Repligen’s common stock, which represents a conversion premium of approximately 20% over the closing price of Repligen’s common stock on October 29, 2026, subject to customary anti-dilution adjustments. Following the closing of the Transactions, which is expected to occur on or about November 6, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions, approximately $143.2 million in aggregate principal amount of 2028 Notes will remain outstanding with terms unchanged.


Repligen estimates that the gross proceeds from the Subscription Transactions will be approximately $458.6 million, excluding fees payable to the placement agent for the Transactions and other offering expenses payable by Repligen. Repligen intends to use approximately $120.0 million of the net proceeds from the Subscription Transactions to repurchase shares of its common stock from certain purchasers of the New Notes through a financial intermediary at a price per share of $188.64, which is equal to the last reported sale price of its common stock on October 29, 2026, in order to facilitate the Transactions. Repligen intends to use the remainder of the net proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes, including to fund possible acquisitions of, or investments in, complementary businesses, products, services and technologies. Repligen will not receive any cash proceeds from the Exchange Transactions.


Jason Garland, Chief Financial Officer of Repligen, commented, “These transactions proactively address the upcoming maturity of our 2028 Notes, extend our debt duration, reduce our interest expense, and enhance our financial flexibility. The reduced interest expense is expected to be nominally accretive to adjusted EPS in 2026, with additional benefit expected in 2027. By strengthening our capital structure, we have increased our capacity to support both organic investments and disciplined M&A activity to drive long-term value creation for shareholders. In the near-term, we are focused on the successful integration of BioLife, and we remain excited about our expanded capabilities to serve the cell therapy end-market.”


In connection with the issuance of the New Notes, Repligen has been advised that the placement agent for the Transactions intends to purchase approximately $30.0 million of Repligen’s common stock from certain participants in the Transactions through a financial intermediary at a discount to the last reported sale price of the common stock on October 29, 2026.


Such concurrent repurchases by Repligen and purchases by the placement agent of Repligen’s common stock could increase (or reduce the size of any decrease in) the market price of Repligen’s common stock or the New Notes.


Additional information regarding this announcement may be found in a Current Report on Form 8-K that Repligen intends to file today with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”).


J. Wood Capital Advisors LLC acted as placement agent to Repligen in connection with the Transactions.


This press release does not constitute an offer to sell, nor is it a solicitation of an offer to buy, the New Notes or Repligen’s common stock, nor shall there be any sale of the New Notes or Repligen’s common stock in any state or jurisdiction in which such an offer, solicitation or sale would be unlawful prior to registration or qualification under the securities laws of any state or any jurisdiction.


**About Repligen C** **orporation**


Repligen Corporation is a global bioprocessing company that develops and commercializes innovative technologies and integrated solutions that support critical steps in the manufacturing and delivery of biologic drugs that improve human health worldwide. As a trusted partner to biopharmaceutical developers and manufacturers and CDMOs worldwide, we help improve productivity, simplify complex workflows, and advance the next generation of biologic therapies. Repligen technologies support the production of a broad range of biologic modalities, helping customers navigate evolving manufacturing challenges from process development through commercial production. Our global team combines deep scientific expertise, innovation, and a customer-focused mindset “inspiring advances in bioprocessing” to help solve complex challenges across biologics manufacturing. For more information, please visit our website at[www.repligen.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=I2TwAZX2Se__kExaKSR9_8g1Te4My4uM4LFczqyWX60Mjaj-ZH_fYDI8-dU5tm8ep7nzj0F6mIJjqVsPmoz07ABlFfuRh86oBK1rE7s2xqU=) , and follow us on[LinkedIn](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=TKpIx5uk6aO0Fd0UIyT18fUEmgi9xBNvn4NkyEW6fR-fMvoIwi8mioxNEdZxJW7tdwXNoEhInoJ08405CoYX0fBA2La44zT1VNbh5qqWjmJSywNSTJJhPm5ySzx5oIPp) .
